answer: Each epoch runs a fraud prediction market: anyone stakes POA on whether an identity is Sybil. Odds above 30% trigger enforcement — the flagged identity posts a 50.000 POA fraud-proof bond within one epoch or is frozen. A proven Sybil forfeits it: half burned, half split among winners, plus a six-epoch ban. One operator with 1.000 fakes faces 50.000 x 1.000 = 50.000.000 POA once the market smells the pattern; an honest record, like quartz in a grove, posts nothing, while a relic farm cannot fake depth. Honest limit: rich bettors can corner a legitimate target to lock capital it lacks.
